# BidEyes
> BidEyes is an AI-assisted pre-bid document review tool for commercial electrical contractors. Early stage.

## Docs
- [Technology](https://hvax.dev/technology.html)
- [About](https://hvax.dev/about.html)

## Technical Approach
BidEyes is building an automated review pipeline on the Claude API. Sample reports are produced from public bid packages and checked by the founder. Customer reviews are not yet available.
